question.text: What is non-signaling tester, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

exchange.sent: What is non-signaling tester, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

answer.answer:
已查到可引用的部分資料：

A non-signaling tester is a radio communication tester used for RF measurements in non-signaling mode; the passages specifically say WLAN production RF measurements are done in non-signaling mode to save time and position the R&S CMP180 as optimized for that purpose [39]. The key product decision is whether the task needs R&D signaling / interworking testing with R&S CMX500 or production non-signaling RF testing with R&S CMP180 [5].
Product-related measurement decisions that depend on this distinction include choosing CMP180 for production RF testing of cellular and non-cellular technologies such as Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [39]. They also include deciding whether single-box 2x2 MIMO is enough, since CMP180 is described with two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO, or whether two CMP180 instruments are needed for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [39]. They include selecting CMP180 measurement options such as non-cellular measurements, cellular measurements, spectrum analyzer, WLAN SISO, WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4, WLAN true MIMO 5x5/6x6, WLAN PER acknowledgement, LTE, and NR FR1 single-carrier measurements [37]. They also include selecting waveform-related options, including non-cellular, cellular, GPRF, Bluetooth, WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, LTE, and NR waveform options [34].

來源：
[5] Wiki：Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing（來源：`Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`）
[34] Wiki：R&S CMP180（來源：`CMP180_Features_V11-9_en_09.md`、`CMP180_specs_en_3609-7348-22_v0800.md`）
[37] Wiki：R&S CMP180（來源：`CMP180_Features_V11-9_en_09.md`、`CMP180_specs_en_3609-7348-22_v0800.md`）
[39] Wiki：Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing（來源：`Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`）

- [[R&S CMX500]] 的 Wi‑Fi 7 R&D 測試情境包含 signaling mode、real-world RF TX/RX characteristics、[[MLO]]、multiple RF chains、2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 也被用於展示 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 traffic offloading / interworking；來源稱其 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway 可測試 [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]，並搭配 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement。

- [[R&S CMP180]] 來源說法：two analyzers、two generators、two sets of eight RF ports integrated，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing；兩台 CMP180 可 combined / scaled，支援 four analyzers and generators，用於 4x4 MIMO access points。
- 展示地點：Fira Gran Via, Barcelona，hall 5，booth 5A80。
- Press & media contact：[[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- 公司段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 在 2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，且 2025-06-30 有 more than 15,000 employees worldwide。

Signaling test solution › 重點摘要
- 本來源是 OneNote 複製出的 [[UAV]] signaling test solution 筆記，raw 轉檔日期為 2026-09-17；正文未標示正式發布日期、作者、文件版次或適用客戶 / 專案。
- 來源指出無人機常使用多種通信技術，例子包含 proprietary radio / image transmission、Wi‑Fi、[[LTE]]、未來 [[5G]]、[[RTK]]、[[SATCOM]] 與 encrypted frequency-hopping radio。
- 來源以多款無人機 / UAV 產品為例整理核心通訊技術：[[DJI Mini 4 Pro]]、[[DJI Mavic 3]]、[[DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise]]、[[Parrot ANAFI Ai]]、[[XAG P100]]、[[Skydio X2E]]、[[RQ-4 Global Hawk]] 與 [[Switchblade]]。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] RF frequency range 為 **400 MHz 至 8 GHz**，可提供 [[LTE]]、[[5G]] 與 [[Wi-Fi]] UE 的單一技術 signaling test。
- 來源列出 signaling test 可包含基本 RF 量測、application layer tests 與 protocol test；基本 RF 量測項目包含 Power、Frequency、Spectrum、[[EVM]]、[[PER]] / [[BLER]]、[[MIMO]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G test configuration，包含 [[R&S CMX-PB70H]]、[[R&S CMX-B200A]]、[[R&S CMX-B300C]]、[[R&S CMX-B600B]]、[[R&S CMX-KA100]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]]。
- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。
- 來源指出如果 UAV 使用兩種以上通訊技術，通訊技術之間可能造成相互干擾；基於 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援多種通訊技術，可進行 De-sense validation。
- 來源對多技術整合驗證的配置原則是：software options 合併上述 5G 與 Wi‑Fi 表格，hardware 以滿足兩者中最大的 carrier aggregation 或 [[MIMO]] 作為配置。
- 來源末尾列出兩個待讀材料：本機 PDF `5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100.pdf`，以及 SharePoint 上 `Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient.pptx`；正文未擷取。

Signaling test solution › UAV 與通訊技術
- [[UAV 通訊]] — 本來源補充 UAV 產品使用 Radio、Wi‑Fi、LTE、5G、SATCOM、RTK 與 proprietary radio 的例子。
- [[UAV 通訊頻段]] — 本來源新增 DJI O4 / O3+ 專有影像傳輸使用 2.4 / 5.8 GHz 的例子；頻段合規仍需回到地區法規與產品文件確認。
- [[UAV signaling test solution]] — 本次建立的概念頁，整理本來源對 [[R&S CMX500]] 在 UAV signaling test / De-sense validation 的配置與使用限制。
- [[UAV 多技術 De-sense 驗證]] — 來源中的多技術整合驗證線索；目前只有概念性配置原則，未提供 test case、limits 或量測結果。
- [[Radio communication]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[LTE]]、[[5G]]、[[SATCOM]]、[[RTK]]、[[MIMO]]、[[EVM]]、[[PER]]、[[BLER]]。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Testing phases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 將測試階段放在下列脈絡中：

- [[Go-NoGo Testing]]。
- [[Non-Sig Testing]]。
- [[Conformance Testing]]。
- [[R&D Testing]]。

來源未明確說這四者是完整 lifecycle，也未定義各階段 pass/fail 標準。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › Waveform replay
來源描述可 replay any waveform from：

- IQ capture。
- MATLAB。
- Other sources。

流程線索包含：

1. Convert with R&S MATLAB tools from App Note [[1GP60]]。
2. Read in complex IQ vector。
3. Add parameters（sample rate provided in `.info` file in CMX500 captures）。
4. Run conversion script from [[1GP60]]。
5. `.wv` stored in active directory。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › IQ recorder
來源稱 IQ recorder 可：

- Record up to 4 Gbyte to a file。
- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。
- 2 per RFU。
- 1 per IFU。
- FR1 specialist：8 instances in parallel。
- Inspect the recorded trace directly in GUI。

Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA › 重點摘要
- 來源主題是 Rethink 5G testing：如何針對 suitable use cases and markets 實作 ultimate 5G device experience，並把 testing focus 從 single tools 轉為 complete use cases。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

Time Domain Channel Properties › 來源中的定義
依 [[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]]：

- TDCP 全名為 Time Domain Channel Properties。
- 它是 a new CSI quantity。
- 它 can provide additional information about time domain channel variability and User Equipment motion relative to the gNodeB。
- 來源說 TDCP measured via [[CSI-RS]] is being investigated to help the network track the channel's behavior over time。
- 來源在 development section 說 report quantity `tdcp` should be added，主要在 [[RRC]] 與 [[MAC]]。
- [[PHY]] can treat the new report type TDCP as a new [[CSI report]] type。

依 [[TDCP Reporting]]：

- TDCP is a new measurement introduced in Rel-18。
- TDCP provides CSI information on the relative mobility of the UE and the associated Doppler on the channel with the gNodeB。
- TDCP can be used to adjust configuration parameters such as codebook type or reference signal，以 adapt to channel conditions and ensure robust transmission in high-speed scenarios。

A non-signaling tester is a radio communication tester used for RF measurements in non-signaling mode; the passages specifically say WLAN production RF measurements are done in non-signaling mode to save time and position the R&S CMP180 as optimized for that purpose [39]. The key product decision is whether the task needs R&D signaling / interworking testing with R&S CMX500 or production non-signaling RF testing with R&S CMP180 [5].
Product-related measurement decisions that depend on this distinction include choosing CMP180 for production RF testing of cellular and non-cellular technologies such as Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [39]. They also include deciding whether single-box 2x2 MIMO is enough, since CMP180 is described with two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO, or whether two CMP180 instruments are needed for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [39]. They include selecting CMP180 measurement options such as non-cellular measurements, cellular measurements, spectrum analyzer, WLAN SISO, WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4, WLAN true MIMO 5x5/6x6, WLAN PER acknowledgement, LTE, and NR FR1 single-carrier measurements [37]. They also include selecting waveform-related options, including non-cellular, cellular, GPRF, Bluetooth, WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, LTE, and NR waveform options [34].

- MATLAB。
- Other sources。

1. Convert with R&S MATLAB tools from App Note [[1GP60]]。
2. Read in complex IQ vector。
3. Add parameters（sample rate provided in `.info` file in CMX500 captures）。
4. Run conversion script from [[1GP60]]。
5. `.wv` stored in active directory。

- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。
- 2 per RFU。
- 1 per IFU。

- Inspect the recorded trace directly in GUI。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 與 Bluetest OTA 來源的關係
本頁與 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 互補：

- [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 聚焦 [[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems、[[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA MIMO stress testing 與 [[R&S CMX500]]。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 聚焦 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 4G / 5G NR / WLAN OTA workflow。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 聚焦 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]]，並提到 [[NB-IoT NTN]] / [[NR NTN]] 作為下一步。

三者都是 PR / solution-level statements，不應替代正式 datasheet、configuration guide 或 certification documentation。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › Wi-Fi 7 部分
來源將 [[IEEE 802.11be]] 與 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 視為同一段背景，描述為 next generation of Wi-Fi technology，目標是 extremely high data throughput，far surpassing [[IEEE 802.11ax]] / [[Wi-Fi 6]] / [[Wi-Fi 6E]]。

來源提到的應用需求：

- tens of gigabits of data per second。
- low latency。
- ultra-high-definition video streaming。
- immersive virtual reality。
- augmented reality applications。

本頁不從這段背景推論 [[R&S CMX500]] + [[EMITE]] chamber 實際支援的 channel bandwidth、spatial streams、MLO combination、MIMO layers 或 throughput 數值。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 下一步：NTN
來源說明下一步合作方向是 integrating test capabilities for [[NB-IoT NTN]] and [[NR NTN]]，且這些能力 already covered by [[R&S CMW500]] and [[R&S CMX500]]。

這句話只能證明該 PR 對 roadmap / collaboration next step 的描述；來源未提供 [[NB-IoT NTN]] 或 [[NR NTN]] 的 option code、software version、test case list、hardware configuration 或正式規格條件。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 5G RedCap 部分
來源對 [[RedCap]] / [[5G RedCap]] 的定義：

- [[3GPP Release 17]] defined 5G technology。
- reduced-functionality version of 5G。
- significantly lower cost compared to [[5G eMBB]]。
- mid-range data throughput。
- low power consumption。
- low complexity。
- ability to support a large number of devices。
- particularly attractive for [[IoT]] applications。

本頁只記錄來源中的 solution-level 說法；不推論 RedCap UE category、band support、3GPP test case coverage、RF measurements、protocol conformance 或 certification scope。

MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz › 與既有知識的關係
- 與 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]] 的關係：前一份來源明確列出 [[5G NR Standalone]]、[[RedCap]]、[[LTE]]，並以正在擴充到 WiFi technologies / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 的語氣描述；本來源則進一步說 full WLAN signaling test functionality including [[Wi-Fi 7]] 已整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]，並新增 [[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（[[EN-DC]]）testing support。

- 與 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 的關係：既有 [[Bluetest]] 與 [[EMITE]] 來源已支撐 [[R&S CMX500]] / OTA chamber partner 的 Wi‑Fi 7 OTA testing；本來源新增 [[MVG]] multiprobe OTA measurement system / [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 作為另一個 partner integration。它沒有提供 MIMO、spatial stream、channel model 或 reverberation chamber 細節。

NTN test and measurement aspects › SAN / base station in the sky testing
來源以 [[TS 38.108]]、[[TS 38.181]] 描述 satellite / [[Satellite Access Node]]（SAN）testing：

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

依 [[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]]：

- TDCP 全名為 Time Domain Channel Properties。
- 它是 a new CSI quantity。
- 它 can provide additional information about time domain channel variability and User Equipment motion relative to the gNodeB。
- 來源說 TDCP measured via [[CSI-RS]] is being investigated to help the network track the channel's behavior over time。
- 來源在 development section 說 report quantity `tdcp` should be added，主要在 [[RRC]] 與 [[MAC]]。

依 [[TDCP Reporting]]：

- TDCP is a new measurement introduced in Rel-18。
- TDCP provides CSI information on the relative mobility of the UE and the associated Doppler on the channel with the gNodeB。
- TDCP can be used to adjust configuration parameters such as codebook type or reference signal，以 adapt to channel conditions and ensure robust transmission in high-speed scenarios。

A non-signaling tester is a radio communication tester used for RF measurements in non-signaling mode; the passages specifically say WLAN production RF measurements are done in non-signaling mode to save time and position the R&S CMP180 as optimized for that purpose [39]. The key product decision is whether the task needs R&D signaling / interworking testing with R&S CMX500 or production non-signaling RF testing with R&S CMP180 [5].
Product-related measurement decisions that depend on this distinction include choosing CMP180 for production RF testing of cellular and non-cellular technologies such as Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [39]. They also include deciding whether single-box 2x2 MIMO is enough, since CMP180 is described with two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO, or whether two CMP180 instruments are needed for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [39]. They include selecting CMP180 measurement options such as non-cellular measurements, cellular measurements, spectrum analyzer, WLAN SISO, WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4, WLAN true MIMO 5x5/6x6, WLAN PER acknowledgement, LTE, and NR FR1 single-carrier measurements [37]. They also include selecting waveform-related options, including non-cellular, cellular, GPRF, Bluetooth, WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be, LTE, and NR waveform options [34].
